create.name: Ajahn Brahmali
create.bio:
Ajahn Brahmali is a Norwegian-born Theravāda monk who has lived at Bodhinyana Monastery in Serpentine, south of Perth, since 1994. Born in 1964, he studied engineering and finance before a trip to Japan drew him to meditation. He began monastic life as an anagārika at Amaravati and Chithurst in England, then moved to Western Australia to train under Ajahn Brahm, who was his preceptor when he took full ordination in 1996. He is now a senior monk of the community and its go-to scholar on Pāli and the monastic rule.

His teaching centres on the early discourses of the Buddha, which he unpacks patiently and in plain language. He helped Bhikkhu Bodhi with the English translation of the Aṅguttara Nikāya and, together with Bhante Sujato, wrote The Authenticity of the Early Buddhist Texts. In Perth he gives Friday evening talks, Saturday guided sittings and Sunday sutta classes at the Dhammaloka centre, all streamed on YouTube, and each year he leads a nine-day sutta retreat at Jhana Grove next to the monastery. He also teaches retreats abroad, in recent years in Belgium, Singapore, Indonesia and Sri Lanka.

courses.title: 'Flowing to Freedom' 10-Day Silent Retreat with Ajahn Brahmāli, Ayya Kārunikā and Ven. Vimala
courses.description: A ten-day silent retreat at Yeunten Ling in Belgium, organised by InzichtMeditatie Antwerpen with Samita. Days follow the rhythm of sitting, walking and evening talks on the early teachings; the teaching itself is offered on a donation basis.
courses.price: €460 to €920 EUR (accommodation and meals by room type; teaching by donation)

courses.title: BSWA 9 Day Sutta Retreat with Ajahn Brahmali 28 May – 6 June 2027
courses.description: His yearly residential retreat at Jhana Grove, beside Bodhinyana Monastery, where each day mixes meditation with close study of selected suttas. Places go by ballot to BSWA members first, and the sessions are streamed live on YouTube.
courses.price: $300 AUD room bond (may be donated at the end; BSWA membership needed to book)

free_resources.title: 2026 May | 9 Day Sutta Retreat | Ajahn Brahmali
free_resources.description: All 26 recorded sessions from his May 2026 sutta retreat at Jhana Grove, in order. A full course in reading the early discourses alongside meditation practice, free to watch.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditation by Ajahn Brahmali
free_resources.description: The Buddhist Society of Western Australia's archive of his recorded guided sittings, mostly from Saturday afternoons in Perth. Free to stream.

free_resources.title: Sutta Study with Ajahn Brahmali
free_resources.description: Recordings of his Sunday sutta classes, each working slowly through one discourse of the Buddha with questions from the room. A good companion for anyone reading the suttas on their own.
